news.title: ‘Not today, not here’: Infantino tight-lipped on abandoned World Cup rights proposal
news.lede: FIFA President Gianni Infantino, who attended the opening match of the Under-20 Women's World Cup in Katowice on Saturday, remained tight-lipped about whether he regrets his abandoned proposal to sell a stake in the World Cup. The event is the first tournament organised by world soccer's ruling body since the Swiss administrator called off the plan, which valued the commercial rights of the World Cup and other FIFA tournaments at $20 billion. The proposal was abandoned in late July following a fierce backlash and boycott threats from regional governing bodies, including Europe's UEFA and major stakeholders in the sport. news.title: Gianii Infantino dodges FIFA future questions amid fallout over failed World Cup plan
news.lede: FIFA president Gianni Infantino refused to shed light on his plans for the future as he attended the opening match of the Under-20 Women's World Cup in Poland on Saturday. Infantino was asked about his position amid continued scrutiny following the collapse of his controversial proposal to sell off a share of FIFA's future World Cup profits.Infantino was in the stands as hosts Poland faced Argentina on the opening day of the tournament. Asked by Sky News about his future, the FIFA president said there would be a time to address the issue, but insisted the focus should remain on football.“. news.title: ‘David vs Goliath Basketball Version’ – WNBA World Reacts As Angel Reese Out-Rebounds 7’3” China Star in FIBA World Cup
news.lede: WNBA star Angel Reese made an impact in Team USA’s opening victory over China at the FIBA Women’s Basketball World Cup on Friday. Her signature rebounding against China’s 7’3 center Zhang Ziyu sparked plenty of reactions across social media. Team USA beat China 94-61 in their Group D opener, and while Reese only scored 5 points, she made headlines by out-rebounding the much taller Zhang (9 rebounds to 6). FIBA lists Reese at 190 centimeters and Zhang at 223 centimeters, but the Atlanta Dream star overcame the roughly 13-inch height difference to collect more rebounds.

news.title: Somali referee dropped from 2026 FIFA World Cup after US entry denial
news.lede: Somalian referee Omar Artan, who was set to become the first Somali official to referee at a FIFA World Cup, has been dropped from the list of match officials after being denied entry to the United States. Artan, who was named the 2025 Confederation of African Football Men’s Referee of the Year, was barred from entering the country at Miami International Airport and is currently in Turkey. No reason has been publicly given by US immigration authorities. However, Somalia is among a number of countries included in a travel ban introduced by US President Donald Trump's administration.

news.title: FIFA blasts UEFA ‘smear campaign,’ fights World Cup plan disclosures
news.lede: FIFA has accused UEFA of a "smear campaign" and a "fishing expedition" after European football's governing body asked US judges to force it to hand over documents related to its failed World Cup investor plan. Global soccer body FIFA's divisive plan to sell stakes in the World Cup to investors, unveiled in July, triggered a huge backlash across the sport, with UEFA threatening to boycott the World Cup unless the plan was scrapped. While FIFA quickly aborted the plans in response to the backlash, UEFA is now preparing possible legal action against FIFA president Gianni Infantino for alleged "criminal mismanagement." Last week, it filed requests in three US states requesting the disclosure of documents related to the plan from FIFA and partners, including prospective lead investor Joshua Kushner's Thrive Capital firm.

news.title: Philippines women’s national football team secures qualification for 2027 FIFA Women’s World Cup
news.lede: News On AIR | March 19, 2026 1:13 PM. The Philippines women’s national football team have secured qualification for the 2027 FIFA Women’s World Cup after defeating the Uzbekistan women’s national football team 2-0 in a Women’s Asian Cup play-in match on the Gold Coast today. Angela Beard delivered a standout performance, opening the scoring early in the second half after earlier missed opportunities. She found the net in the 47th minute with a well-taken strike into the roof of the goal.
